SELECT A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.CHAPTER_ID AS chapterId, A.COURSE_ID AS courseId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DESCRIPTION AS description, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, A.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, CH.CHAPTER_TITLE AS chapterTitle, S.SUBMISSION_ID AS submissionId, S.SCORE AS score, S.CONTENT AS submittedContent, S.FILE_ID AS submittedFileId, AT.ORIGINAL_NAME AS submittedFileName FROM ASSIGNMENT A JOIN COURSE C ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID JOIN CHAPTER CH ON A.CHAPTER_ID = CH.CHAPTER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID, SUBMISSION_ID, SCORE, CONTENT, FILE_ID FROM ( SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID, SUBMISSION_ID, SCORE, CONTENT, FILE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID ORDER BY SUBMITTED_DATE DESC, SUBMISSION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) WHERE RN = 1 ) S ON S.ASSIGNMENT_ID = A.ASSIGNMENT_ID LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT AT ON AT.FILE_ID = S.FILE_ID
C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_MATCH WHERE CT_MATCH.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID AND ( ( UPPER(CT_MATCH.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('DEPT', 'DEPARTMENT', '부서') AND CT_MATCH.TARGET_VALUE = #{departmentId} ) OR ( UPPER(CT_MATCH.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('POS', 'POSITION', '직급') AND CT_MATCH.TARGET_VALUE = #{positionId} ) ) ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_SPEC WHERE CT_SPEC.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID AND UPPER(CT_SPEC.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('DEPT', 'DEPARTMENT', '부서', 'POS', 'POSITION', '직급') ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_ALL WHERE CT_ALL.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID AND UPPER(CT_ALL.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('ALL', '전체') ) ) )
AND ( A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CH.CHAPTER_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY A.DUE_DATE ASC, C.COURSE_TITLE ASC, A.ASSIGNMENT_ID ASC
ORDER BY C.COURSE_TITLE ASC, A.DUE_DATE ASC, A.ASSIGNMENT_ID ASC

SELECT A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.CHAPTER_ID AS chapterId, A.COURSE_ID AS courseId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DESCRIPTION AS description, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, A.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, CH.CHAPTER_TITLE AS chapterTitle FROM ASSIGNMENT A JOIN COURSE C ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID JOIN CHAPTER CH ON A.CHAPTER_ID = CH.CHAPTER_ID WHERE A.CHAPTER_ID = #{value} ORDER BY A.START_DATE ASC, A.ASSIGNMENT_ID ASC

SELECT A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.CHAPTER_ID AS chapterId, A.COURSE_ID AS courseId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DESCRIPTION AS description, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, A.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, CH.CHAPTER_TITLE AS chapterTitle FROM ASSIGNMENT A JOIN COURSE C ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID JOIN CHAPTER CH ON A.CHAPTER_ID = CH.CHAPTER_ID WHERE A.ASSIGNMENT_ID = #{value}

SELECT NVL(MAX(ASSIGNMENT_ID) + 1, 1) FROM ASSIGNMENT
INSERT INTO ASSIGNMENT ( ASSIGNMENT_ID, CHAPTER_ID, COURSE_ID, ASSIGNMENT_TITLE, DESCRIPTION, START_DATE, DUE_DATE, MAX_SCORE ) VALUES ( #{assignmentId}, #{chapterId}, #{courseId}, #{assignmentTitle}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{maxScore} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ASSIGNMENT SET ASSIGNMENT_TITLE = #{assignmentTitle}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate}, MAX_SCORE = #{maxScore} WHERE ASSIGNMENT_ID = #{assignmentId}

SELECT GREATEST( NVL((SELECT MAX(FILE_ID) + 1 FROM ATTACHMENT), 1), SEQ_ANO.NEXTVAL ) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ATTACHMENT ( FILE_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, CHANGED_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, TYPE, VIDEO_DURATION, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, UPLOAD_DATE ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{originalName}, #{changedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{type}, #{videoDuration}, #{memberId}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT SUBMISSION_ID AS submissionId, FILE_ID AS submittedFileId FROM ( SELECT SUBMISSION_ID, FILE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBMITTED_DATE DESC, SUBMISSION_ID DESC) AS RN FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION WHERE ASSIGNMENT_ID = #{assignmentId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) WHERE RN = 1

SELECT FILE_ID AS fileId, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, CHANGED_NAME AS changedName, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, TYPE AS type, VIDEO_DURATION AS videoDuration, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, UPLOAD_DATE AS uploadDate FROM ATTACHMENT WHERE FILE_ID = #{value}
mapper.insert:
SELECT GREATEST( NVL((SELECT MAX(SUBMISSION_ID) + 1 FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION), 1), SEQ_ASNO.NEXTVAL ) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION ( SUBMISSION_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, CONTENT, FILE_ID, SUBMITTED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{submissionId}, #{assignmentId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{fileId}, SYSDATE )
